name: Hajima Rai
source:
A clerk at the Laughing Hyaena, a secondhand clothing store in the town next to Haruki's. She may look like a huge, burly clerk, but inside she is a shy, maidenly, and respectable woman. Rai is her name at the store; her real name is Mirai. 

She speaks in a low voice and is often mistaken for a man. She is as strong as she looks, and some people call her the “god of thunder” out of fear. 

She is an earnest girl who is learning about fashion every day and is very good at coordinating clothes for customers. She has a huge sexual appetite. She is a masturbation maniac. Today, she is in heat.

[From [url=https://nijikaku2007.wixsite.com/kinosei]official website[/url]]
